Import packages
```{r include = TRUE, message=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
library(dartR)
library(ggplot2)
library(adegenet) 
library(ape)
```

Import data
```{r}
#Set working directory 
setwd("~/Desktop/Conservation-Genomics/1_SNP_quality_control_filtering/SC")

#Import the DArT genotype CSV file and the complementary CSV file containing sample metadata.
gl <- gl.read.dart(filename = "Report_DAstr22-6749_SNP_2.csv", ind.metafile = "SC_metadata.csv")

#Print details
gl

#Check the order of individual names. If individuals are not sorted alphabetically, proceed to the next step.
indNames(gl)

#Sort all individuals by population in alphabetical order
gl <- gl[order(pop(gl)), ]

#Verify the new ordering of individuals
indNames(gl)
```

Check for potential clone mates
```{r }
#Method 1 - calculating the proportion of shared alleles
clones <- gl.propShared(gl)

#Convert matrix into data frame 
clones_temp <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(clones)))
write.csv(clones_temp, file = "SC_clones.csv")

#Method 2 - Neighbour-joining tree
NJ <- dist(tab(gl))
tree <- nj(NJ)
plot(tree, cex=0.5)

#Export tree into Nexus format for visualisation in FigTree
write.nexus(trec, file = "SC_clones_NJ.nex") 
```

Remove potential clones
```{r}
gla <- gl.drop.ind(gl, ind.list=c("SC_103A_2A","SC_24C_4A","SC_24C_4B","SC_76A_3A","SC_95_5A",            #Technical replicates      
                                  "SC_45_2B","SC_8_1A","SC_84_1B","SC_107A_6A","SC_107A_6B","SC_103A_2B",
                                  "SC_107A_3","SC_76A_4","SC_107A_5","SC_107A_4","SC_107A_2",   #Clones and/or misidentified species
                                  "SC_40A_6","SC_42_6","SC_69A_2","SC_42_4","SC_104_6",
                                  "SC_104_5","SC_15_3","SC_40A_1","SC_104_4","SC_104_2",
                                  "SC_69A_6","SC_40A_4","SC_15_1","SC_104_3","SC_104_1",
                                  "SC_15_2","SC_15_4","SC_15_5","SC_101E_1","SC_101E_2",
                                  "SC_101E_3","SC_101E_4","SC_101E_5","SC_101E_6","SC_24C_1",
                                  "SC_24C_2","SC_24C_3","SC_24C_5","SC_24C_6","SC_49A_2",
                                  "SC_49A_3","SC_49A_4","SC_49A_5","SC_49A_6","SC_38A_2",
                                  "SC_38A_3","SC_38A_4","SC_40A_2","SC_40A_3","SC_40A_5",
                                  "SC_107A_1","SC_98A_3","SC_15_6","SC_49A_1","SC_24C_3"))

#Print details
gla
```

Reports on minor allele frequencies (maf) overall, and by population
```{r }
pdf("SC_maf_gla.pdf", height=20, width=20)
gl.report.maf(gla)
dev.off()
```

Filters loci by maf
```{r }
pdf("SC_maf_glb.pdf")
glb <- gl.filter.maf(gla, threshold = 0.05)
dev.off()

#Print details
glb
```

Report Call Rates/ Missing Data - loci
```{r }
pdf("SC_report_callrate_loc_glb.pdf")
gl.report.callrate(glb, method='loc')
dev.off()
```

Report Call Rates/ Missing Data - individuals
```{r }
pdf("SC_report_callrate_ind_glb.pdf")
gl.report.callrate(glb, method='ind')
dev.off()
```

Calculate call rate for each locus
```{r }
pdf("SC_callrate_loc_glc.pdf")
glc <- gl.filter.callrate(glb, method="loc", threshold=0.8)
dev.off()

#Print details
glc
```

Calculate call rate for each individual
```{r }
pdf("SC_callrate_ind_gld.pdf")
gld <- gl.filter.callrate(glc, method="ind", threshold=0.8)
dev.off()

#Print details
gld
```

Discard loci that might be possible paralogues (hamming distance)
```{r }
pdf("SC_paralogues_gle.pdf")
gle <- gl.filter.hamming(gld, threshold=0.2)
dev.off()
  
#Print details
gle

save(gle, file="SC_gle.rdata")
```

Compare smear plots between the original and filtered datasets
```{r }
pdf("SC_original_dataset_gl.pdf")
plot(gl) 
dev.off() 

pdf("SC_filtered_dataset_gle.pdf")
plot(gle)
dev.off()
```
